exploreItems.title: Period and concern

exploreItems.discovery: The entry dates the uprising to 1621 and connects it with earlier religious practices.

exploreItems.title: Limit
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Limited biographical records do not justify invented conversations or universal motives.

exploreItems.title: Named action
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.

exploreItems.title: Sequence
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: The leadership change belongs to 1763.

exploreItems.title: Source limit
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: A later marker does not supply every meeting, member or private motive.

exploreItems.title: Locate
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Keep a named uprising attached to its place and period.

exploreItems.title: Order
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: The selected beginnings are 1621, 1649 and 1807.

exploreItems.title: Connection needs evidence
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Chronological order alone does not prove coordination or causation.

exploreItems.title: Rule and livelihood
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: A policy can shape production and selling choices.

exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: The 1807 Basi case is connected with a government monopoly.

exploreItems.title: Evidence limit
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: A policy connection does not establish every persons motive or the full chronology.

exploreItems.title: People
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Leaders and households are different subjects.

exploreItems.title: Evidence
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: A biography can establish a leadership change.

exploreItems.title: Limits
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.

exploreItems.title: Movement span
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.

exploreItems.title: Personal limit
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Its founder did not necessarily lead every stage, and his death date is uncertain in the cited account.

exploreItems.title: Changing stages
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Duration alone does not prove identical conditions or participants throughout.

exploreItems.title: Different conditions
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Resources and pressures could affect available choices.

exploreItems.title: Recorded role
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: A source supports particular actions, not every part of a life.

exploreItems.title: No stereotype
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Gender, religion or ancestry does not automatically determine a role or motive.

exploreItems.title: Reach
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: A source may describe a movement spreading beyond an initial place.

exploreItems.title: Joining
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Participation needs evidence about people and actions.

exploreItems.title: Difference
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Affected residents and participants are not automatically the same people.

exploreItems.title: Named case
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: The Basi example concerns Ilocos in 1807 and opposition to a monopoly.

exploreItems.title: Separate dates
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: The event of 1807 and the painting series of 1821 are different stages.

exploreItems.title: Limits
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: A policy concern and later depiction do not reveal every participants motives.

exploreItems.title: Different questions
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Religious practice and political authority are related but distinct questions.

exploreItems.title: Possible overlap
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: One historical concern can connect with more than one aspect of life.

exploreItems.title: No automatic motive
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: A revolt label does not reveal every persons belief or aim.

exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: The Basi Revolt took place.

exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: The paintings were made later.

exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Later cultural recognition is different from an immediate outcome.

exploreItems.title: Reported concern
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.

exploreItems.title: Organization
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: The sources also describe local communities and government.

exploreItems.title: Scope
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: A trigger and an institution do not explain every person or every year of the movement.

exploreItems.title: Role
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: A leader summary identifies a particular guiding or organizing role.

exploreItems.title: Wider participation
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: A named leader is not a complete participant list.

exploreItems.title: Scope
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Being a resident or being affected does not automatically mean joining.

fields.title: Early Resistance Evidence Challenge
fields.description: Complete 10 activities: five clue-and-conclusion decisions and five matching tasks. Choose both the supporting clue and its conclusion for each evidence decision. Get at least 7 activities correct. All supplied clues are available without saving them in your journal.
